errors.error_description: Introduced an incomplete case statement in a combinational always block with no default and without initializing overflow_next, causing a latch inference for overflow_next.
Assigned a 16-bit signal to an 8-bit wire (dbg_bus = result), causing truncation of the upper bits.
Drove the same net (shared_wire) from two continuous assignments, creating multiple active drivers and bus contention.
Drove an input port internally using a continuous assignment (assign op[0] = mode), violating port directionality and assigning to a variable port.
